name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach and blend into a smooth puree.
Saute onions, garlic and ginger until golden.
Add tomatoes and spices; cook until oil separates.
Stir in spinach puree and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add paneer cubes and cream; cook 3 more minutes.
description: Creamy Indian curry made with fresh spinach and soft paneer cheese.

name: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast sourdough slices until golden.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Spread avocado mixture on toast.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle red pepper flakes.
description: Simple, nutritious breakfast with creamy avocado on crispy sourdough.

name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice mozzarella and tomatoes into rounds.
Arrange alternating slices on a plate.
Tuck basil leaves between slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper.
description: Classic Italian salad with fresh mozzarella, tomatoes and basil.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat.
Add garlic and ginger; stir for 30 seconds.
Add hard vegetables (carrot, broccoli) first; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add bell pepper and snap peas; cook 2 more minutes.
Pour soy sauce and toss to coat.
description: Quick and healthy stir-fry loaded with colorful fresh vegetables.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend oats into flour.
Mash banana and mix with egg, milk and vanilla.
Combine with oat flour and baking powder.
Cook on a non-stick pan over medium heat until bubbles form; flip.
Drizzle with honey to serve.
description: Fluffy, naturally sweet pancakes made with banana and rolled oats.

name: Hummus & Veggie Wrap
steps: Spread hummus generously over the tortilla.
Layer spinach leaves on top.
Add sliced cucumber, bell pepper and carrot strips.
Squeeze lemon juice over vegetables.
Roll tightly and slice in half.
description: Fresh and filling wrap packed with crunchy vegetables and creamy hummus.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Roast tomatoes and garlic in oven at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Saute onion in olive oil until soft.
Add roasted tomatoes and broth; simmer 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in cream and fresh basil; season to taste.
description: Velvety roasted tomato soup with fresh basil and a swirl of cream.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon greek yogurt into a glass.
Layer granola on top.
Add mixed berries.
Drizzle honey and sprinkle chia seeds.
Repeat layers if desired.
description: Protein-rich parfait layered with granola, fresh berries and honey.

name: Chickpea Tacos
steps: Season chickpeas with cumin, paprika, salt and pepper.
Roast at 200°C for 20 minutes until crispy.
Warm taco shells.
Fill with chickpeas, shredded cabbage and avocado slices.
Top with cilantro and a squeeze of lime.
description: Crispy roasted chickpea tacos with fresh toppings and lime.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Saute onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add mushrooms; cook until golden.
Add arborio rice and toast for 1 minute.
Pour in wine; stir until absorbed.
Add warm broth ladle by ladle, stirring constantly.
Finish with parmesan and butter.
description: Creamy Italian risotto with earthy mushrooms and aged parmesan.

name: Bruschetta
steps: Slice baguette and toast under broiler.
Rub each slice with a garlic clove.
Dice tomatoes and mix with basil, olive oil and balsamic.
Season with salt and pile onto toast.
description: Classic Italian appetizer with fresh tomatoes and basil on toasted bread.

name: Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend frozen banana, mango and spinach with almond milk until thick.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with granola, sliced kiwi and coconut flakes.
description: Thick and vibrant smoothie bowl topped with fresh fruit and granola.

name: Lentil Soup
steps: Saute onion, garlic and carrot in olive oil.
Add cumin and turmeric; stir 1 minute.
Add lentils and broth; bring to a boil.
Simmer 20 minutes until lentils are soft.
Blend partially and finish with lemon juice.
description: Hearty and warming red lentil soup spiced with cumin and turmeric.

name: Guacamole & Chips
steps: Mash avocados in a bowl.
Mix in lime juice, diced red onion, jalapeño and cilantro.
Fold in diced tomato.
Season with salt.
Serve with tortilla chips.
description: Fresh homemade guacamole with just the right amount of lime and heat.

name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Preheat oven to 250°C with a pizza stone.
Stretch dough into a round.
Spread tomato sauce evenly.
Top with torn mozzarella.
Bake 10-12 minutes until crust is golden.
Finish with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.
description: Classic Neapolitan pizza with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil.
